title: burst-response-gap-probe-and-contact-grid-2026-12-07
content:
Purpose:
Quick ad-hoc tracker to probe recent burst failures where runtime routing pruned routes (auto-shed) and left caller endpoints with ambiguous owner/contact. Lightweight grid for outreach and short-term mitigation while we correlate telemetry. Not intended as canonical source of truth — temporary patch until product-ops passes owners to the routing guild.

Scope & constraints:
- Time window: incidents between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-06 (spikes during morning US-east window).
- Systems: hosted-api -> routing layer -> fallback engine -> dedicated clusters.
- Focus: 1) identify routes that were pruned/autodarkened, 2) map to last known owner/team, 3) capture a contact (pager or slack), 4) short mitigation (temp-fallback target).

How to use this sheet (notes to self):
- Add a line per route; try to include route-id, last deploy tag, recent error class, rough TPS at time-of-shed.
- If owner unknown, mark "Unclaimed" and ping #runtime-alerts with the snippet below.
- Keep mitigation entries short — prefer a single fallback route id + expiry timestamp.

Sample rows (columns: route, shard, incident-timestamp, error-class, last-owner, contact, temp-mitigation, follow-up):
1) /v1/generate-longform, shard: us-east-1a, 2026-12-02T08:11Z, ERR_SHEd_02, last-owner: se-pilot, contact: @maya (pager), temp-mitigation: route->/v1/generate-longform-small (expires 2026-12-03T12:00Z), follow-up: create JIRA-OPS-4123
2) /embeddings/bulk, shard: eu-west-1b, 2026-12-03T09:04Z, ERR_CACHE_EVICT, last-owner: Unclaimed, contact: (blank), temp-mitigation: route->/embeddings/smaller-batch (expires 2026-12-04T18:00Z), follow-up: ping #runtime-alerts
3) /chat/stream, shard: us-west-2c, 2026-12-05T14:22Z, ERR_RATE_SHIELD, last-owner: infra-edges, contact: oncall-infra@redwood, temp-mitigation: lower-burst-threshold on edge, follow-up: postmortem (owner infra-edges)

Immediate next actions (short checklist):
- [ ] Theo to run quick telemetry join (routes x shed-events) and paste raw hits into sheet (column: raw-events-link).
- [ ] Riley to ping #runtime-alerts for all "Unclaimed" owners with templated ask below.
- [ ] Maya to propose 72-hour fallback window policy for temp-mitigations.
- [ ] Liam to create (if missing) a lightweight owner-lookup doc in confluence and add mapping for top 30 routes.

Templated slack ping (use for Unclaimed routes):
"Heads up — observed auto-prune on route <route> at <ts>. No owner listed in tracker. Can any runtime/routing owners claim? Short ask: confirm owner or suggest temp-fallback within 6 hours so we can restore coverage. TL;DR: route <route>, shard <shard>, error <err>. See sheet: <link>."

Open questions & heuristics (notes):
- Heuristic for tombstoned owners: if last-owner field empty AND last-deploy > 90 days use tag "likely-orphan" and prioritize for reclaim.
- Should we prefer fallback to a smaller model variant in same zone vs cross-region? Latency tradeoff — ask SRE if cross-region outweighs SLA hit.
- If a route has repeated prunes (>2 in 7d) mark as "unstable" and route to engineering triage.

Quick metrics snapshot (to paste from telemetry):
- Unique routes pruned in window: 24 (top 10 account for 72% of requests lost)
- Median time-to-mitigation when owner present: 1h 12m
- Median time-to-mitigation when owner absent: 9h 30m

Notes-to-self (raw, messy):
- Need a shorter path to attach owners to routes in the console. Current mapping buried in product-ops doc.
- Consider a small signal: owner-absent -> escalate to oncall-bot that notifies both routing and product-ops with action token.
- We should make a tiny webhook that creates fallback rules automatically given an admin token (but gate by 1hr expiry auto-delete).

History/log of edits (very brief):
- 2026-12-07 Riley created sheet and seeded 6 routes from initial alert.
- 2026-12-08 Theo added telemetry joins + raw-event links.
- 2026-12-09 Maya proposed fallback expiry policy in notes.

Contact ladder (if you need to escalate):
- Primary: @maya (product-ops), pager: +1-650-555-0123
- Routing guild lead: theo.alvarez@redwood.com
- SRE oncall: oncall-sre@redwood.com
- Exec notice (only if outage > 4h and >30% coverage loss): ops-leads@redwood.com

Raw-links (add actual) — placeholders in linked_artifacts:

End of scratchpad.
